pages.title: Vacuum Beam Pipe
pages.text: A pipe of containment field glass and metamaterial lined with Casimir plates, so the space inside is emptier than empty. A particle beam runs through it without touching anything at all. Peering inside shows nothing, not even a reflection.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Particle beams scatter off any gas. I lined containment glass with Casimir plates, which push out even virtual particles, and wrapped it in metamaterial. The beam stopped scattering.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Metamaterials.
